title: Non-blocking follow-ups from frontend-stock-detail-current-price-prominent's PR review
description: Tracked, non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #394 (frontend-stock-detail-current-price-prominent, AnalysisResponse.current_price/current_price_change_pct + the CurrentPriceDisplay component). See that PR's review comment and docs/tasks/frontend-stock-detail-current-price-prominent.json's review.comments for full context. (PR #394's blocking tsc finding -- three stale AnalysisResponse-typed test fixtures -- is tracked via the parent task's own needs_work verdict/re-review, not here.)

checklist.step: docs/architecture/API.md's `GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/analysis` section (the response JSON example and the per-field prose below it) was never updated to document the new `current_price`/`current_price_change_pct` fields, even though every other field on this response gets a full paragraph there and the task's own description explicitly called for updating this doc 'if its own response-shape listing needs it' -- confirmed it does. In particular, the existing sentence documenting which fields are 'unaffected by trading_mode either way' (listing support_resistance_zones/profit_target/extended_data/insider_clusters/as_of) should also name current_price/current_price_change_pct, since they follow the exact same always-swing-derived rule (confirmed correct in code and tested in TestDayTraderMode) but currently go unmentioned there. Add the two fields to the JSON example and give them the same prose treatment as their neighbors.

backend/app/api/routers/stocks.py's `get_analysis` docstring has the same gap as the API.md one above, in miniature: the paragraph enumerating which fields stay swing-data-derived regardless of trading_mode ('support_resistance_zones/profit_target/extended_data/insider_clusters/as_of are unaffected either way...') doesn't mention current_price/current_price_change_pct, even though the inline comment directly above their computation (and AnalysisResponse.current_price's own Field description) already states this. Add them to that enumerated list for consistency.

decisions.decision: Addressed pr-reviewer's needs_work finding on PR #395 by running `python scripts/export_openapi.py` from backend/ on this branch and committing the resulting backend/openapi.json diff.
decisions.rationale: The diff was exactly the single-line description-field update at the /api/stocks/{ticker}/analysis GET operation that pr-reviewer predicted (git diff --stat confirmed no other change) -- the docstring edit from this task's earlier commit (f225d431) is embedded verbatim as that operation's OpenAPI description per CLAUDE.md's API documentation standard, so regenerating the committed snapshot was the correct and only fix; no alternative was considered since the finding was unambiguous and mechanical.

comments.summary: (Resolved from prior needs_work round.) backend/openapi.json was not regenerated after the get_analysis docstring change. Re-verified on commit 29b2ff2b: independently re-ran `python scripts/export_openapi.py` from backend/ and diffed against the committed snapshot -- zero diff, genuinely in sync now. `git diff main...HEAD -- backend/openapi.json` shows exactly the single predicted description-field line changed at the /api/stocks/{ticker}/analysis GET operation, nothing else moved.

Non-blocking (code-review, medium effort): this PR's new docs/architecture/API.md prose for `current_price_change_pct` says it's null only when fewer than 2 daily bars are available, but the code (`previous_close != 0` check in stocks.py's get_analysis) also returns null when the prior bar's close is exactly 0.0 -- a case the new sentence doesn't mention, and which could mislead a reader into thinking null is impossible once >=2 bars exist. Pre-existing: `backend/app/api/schemas.py`'s `current_price_change_pct` Field description has the identical omission (not touched by this PR), so this PR reproduces rather than introduces the gap. Tracked as a follow-up rather than blocking, since it's an edge-case documentation completeness nit, not a behavior bug.

review.notes: Re-review after task-worker's fix commit (29b2ff2b). Independently confirmed: (1) `python scripts/export_openapi.py` produces no diff against the committed backend/openapi.json -- snapshot is genuinely current; (2) full PR diff (`gh pr diff 395`) reviewed line-by-line -- stocks.py docstring edit, openapi.json's matching 1-line description regeneration, docs/architecture/API.md prose, and task-board bookkeeping only, no application code/behavior change; (3) backend ruff (`ruff check .`), mypy (scoped `mypy` per pyproject's `files=["app"]`), pytest+coverage (1618 passed, 99.94% line coverage), scripts/validate_tasks.py, and scripts/check_profit_target_wording.py all clean; frontend unchanged (last known clean from prior round, no frontend files touched here). No UI surface -- browser walkthrough and e2e suite correctly skipped, same as prior round. code-review (medium effort) dispatched against the diff; it independently verified the docstring/API.md text against the actual implementation and the regenerated openapi.json, and surfaced one non-blocking documentation-completeness nit (previous_close == 0 edge case, see review.comments) that reproduces a pre-existing gap in schemas.py rather than introducing a new one -- tracked as a follow-up, not blocking. All prior blocking finding resolved.
